Priestess of Light Altea:
When sudden and drastic changes started happening here, the Priests of Light came to the conclusion that it was all caused by Chaos Power.
A lot of strange things have been happening all over the continent lately. We try to study them all in great detail. Our forces are spread thin, so we were only able to send a small team to the Snowy Volcano.
However, the conditions here proved to be much harsher than we expected. The monsters were much stronger, too. Many explorer died out in the field.
